evidence: AssetRegistry hard dependencies plus bounded UE Python loading for 105 directly referencing NiagaraSystems, 72 reachable MaterialInstanceConstants, and 101 Texture2Ds. A separate bounded renderer pass enumerated all sprite renderer subobjects for those roots and read each exact renderer SubImageSize plus material texture parameters.
limitations: Texture2D.Source is protected in UE Python; dimensions are the built Texture2D dimensions, not proof of source atlas frames.

The renderer query proves serialized SpriteRenderer SubImageSize values and renderer material texture parameter values. It does not prove the Niagara SubUV module execution, playback behavior, or visual result.
Texture2D.Source is protected in UE Python; source pixel format is not directly exposed. Texture dimensions alone do not establish an atlas grid.
The subsequent batch export stopped on a UE SupportsTexture assertion after 14 PNG/EXR outputs; no export is claimed for uncompleted textures. See texture-export-attempt.json.
One UE commandlet invocation first exited on a Python syntax error before any asset load; the corrected bounded rerun completed with exit code 0.
